hero.intro: This is the route that took me from the shop counter to code. Hop on, I'll show you every stop.

about.paragraph1: I spent 12 years working face to face with customers and learned the most important thing about any product: understanding the people who use it. Then I studied web development (DAW), did an internship as a developer and completed the Full Stack bootcamp at Factoría F5.
about.paragraph2: Today I build apps with Java, Spring Boot and Vue, writing the tests first.
